Kyenele: Mak Kiañiŋ Balaŋ ('Mak long tokples Kyenele long Nuigini') [Gospel of Mark in Kyenele]. eBible.org digital edition KQLPBT (PDF regenerated 2026-08 from source files dated 2025-05-07; also HTML, USFM, ePub), 99 pp. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
sources.note: Nothing. The file is the Mark text (16 chapters) with section headings, cross-references and a few glossary footnotes, followed by the eBible copyright page; there is no translators' preface, alphabet chart or pronunciation note. The practical orthography (a b d e f g i ɨ j k l m n ñ ŋ o p s t u v w y) carries no accent or tone marks, which is weak negative evidence at most, not a statement.

sources.note: Nothing in prose. Survey/lexicostatistics only (sec. 3 p.279 Kyaimbarang list taken at Erem 30 June 1979; sec. 5.4 p.282 Kyaimbarang = Miyak, 81% cognate with Dye's Asangamut list).
